calibration: Past7 complete days, daily. Center log median; scale=max(0.1,1.4826MAD(logvolume)). Ref freezes from first positive CUSUM excursion until reset. Both variants freeze from the first positive standardized excursion, with identical reset logic. No future labels/price filters in scan.
cusum: S=max(0,S+clip(log(volume/base)/scale,-4,4)-0.5). Actual alarm at S>=4/8/12. No backdating to estimated change point. Sensitivities all retained; not chosen by outcomes.
confirm: Only following closed5m candles, within60m after alarm, at least3 above frozenQ90 among last4, median>=2base. Earliest confirmation+15m. End at6 consecutive <=Q75, gap or7d expiry; then rearm. Baseline never adapts inside this episode.
coverage: Independent original x2 zones after7d; association if new alarm in preceding7d. This loose association is not causal identification of the same pump; false counts/new signal outcomes and no20 are reported separately. Original unrecognized pumps outside zones have no independent ground truth.
outcome: From actual early/confirmation close, full1/7d future. Drawdown peak-to-trough; adverse min from entry. Missing/rightedge censored. Change and before10/20 relative to close immediately before frozen calibration day, not retrospectively chosen trough.
provenance_note: source retains the completed replay version; later edits correct protocol wording and compact public export only, without changing scan() or outcomes.
